title: CORE-7026 · Trustpilot & Google review cards missing hover state
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7026](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7026/rf-shared-trustpilot-and-google-review-cards-missing-hover-state) · state `In Progress` · priority P4

## Ticket (verbatim from Linear)

## Impacted pages (35 — every page carrying the "How we are rated" widget)

**FAQ pages (24, from the CMS):** `/faqs` · `/faqs/after-company-formation` · `/faqs/annual-accounts` · `/faqs/basics` · `/faqs/company-meetings-and-resolutions` · `/faqs/company-names` · `/faqs/company-records-and-registers` · `/faqs/company-secretary` · `/faqs/confirmation-statement` · `/faqs/corporation-tax` · `/faqs/directors` · `/faqs/directors-service-address` · `/faqs/limited-by-guarantee` · `/faqs/limited-by-shares` · `/faqs/limited-liability-partnerships` · `/faqs/paye-and-payroll` · `/faqs/paying-yourself-through-limited-company` · `/faqs/pscs` · `/faqs/registered-office` · `/faqs/sail-address` · `/faqs/self-assessment` · `/faqs/shares-and-shareholders` · `/faqs/the-formation-process` · `/faqs/vat`

**Service pages (11):** `/business-telephone/` · `/company-dissolution/` · `/company-name-change/` · `/confirmation-statement-service/` · `/director-appointment-resignation/` · `/dormant-company-accounts/` · `/ico-registration/` · `/issue-of-shares/` · `/psc-filing/` · `/transfer-of-shares/` · `/vat-registration/`

FAQ list taken from the CMS, not sampled: every page in the Payload `pages` collection whose layout contains a `reviewRatings` block. Behaviour verified directly on `/faqs`, `/faqs/vat`, `/faqs/directors`, `/faqs/pscs`, `/faqs/company-secretary`, `/faqs/self-assessment`, `/faqs/the-formation-process` and all 11 service pages — identical on each; the remaining FAQ pages use the same shared component. As more pages are built on the clone, any that add the `reviewRatings` block will inherit this too.
**Component:** "How we are rated" reviews widget — Trustpilot card and Google card
**Breakpoints:** All (360 / 768 / 1024 / 1800) — the state is missing at every width

---

## Issue

On live, hovering a review card gives it a light grey background. On the clone the cards have no hover state at all — they stay white in every interactive state.

## Expected (Live)

On hover, card background transitions transparent → `rgb(248, 248, 248)`, and both the border and the card text also shift to `rgb(0, 177, 227)`. Rule: `.CustomerReviews--pane--epbma:hover`. Applies to both the Trustpilot and Google cards, at all four breakpoints.

## Actual (Clone)

No background change on **any** state — `:hover`, `:focus`, `:focus-visible` or `:active` — on either card, at any breakpoint. The card `<a>` stays `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)` against the white section.

Measured with CDP `CSS.forcePseudoState` (so the state is applied deterministically rather than depending on pointer position), diffing computed styles across every node in the section:

| Site | State | 360 | 768 | 1024 | 1800 |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Live | `:hover` | `#F8F8F8` | `#F8F8F8` | `#F8F8F8` | `#F8F8F8` |
| Clone | `:hover` / `:focus` / `:focus-visible` / `:active` | none | none | none | none |

## Steps to replicate

1. Open `https://rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app/faqs/vat` at any breakpoint.
2. Scroll to "How we are rated".
3. Hover the Trustpilot card → no change. Repeat on the Google card → no change.
4. Compare against `https://www.rapidformations.co.uk/faqs/vat/` → both cards go light grey on hover.

**On touch devices** the difference is more visible than on desktop: tapping a card applies `:hover`, so on live the card turns grey and stays grey until you tap elsewhere. On the clone nothing happens.

## Definition of Done

* Both the Trustpilot and Google review cards take a `rgb(248, 248, 248)` background **and** a `rgb(0, 177, 227)` border/text colour on hover, matching live.
* Applies at all four breakpoints (360 / 768 / 1024 / 1800) — live's rule is not media-gated, so the clone's must not be either.
* The hover target is the whole card (the full `<a>` area, 293×212 at desktop), not just the text or logo.
* Card content — logo, stars, rating text, review count — is unchanged by the hover; only the background changes.
* Surrounding section background and card spacing are unaffected in both states.

## Related

Same component as [CORE-7009](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7009/rf-shared-how-we-are-rated-review-stars-render-largerheavier-than-live) (review stars render larger/heavier than live) — separate defect, same widget.

## Evidence

Hover state forced via CDP so the comparison is deterministic. Live shows the grey card; the clone is indistinguishable from its resting state.

| Breakpoint | Live | Clone |
| -- | -- | -- |
| **1800** |  |  |
| **768** |  |  |
| **360** |  |  |

The 360 pair is shot at whole-section scope (heading + card + carousel dots) because at mobile the card sits inside a carousel and a tight crop clips it. 1024 measured identically to 1800; screenshots not attached for that width.

Confirmed on every service page listed under **Impacted pages** by driving a real mouse hover onto the Trustpilot card and reading computed style before/after, at 360 and 1800:

|  | On hover |
| -- | -- |
| **Live** | background `rgba(0,0,0,0)` → `rgb(248,248,248)`, border → `rgb(0,177,227)`, text → `rgb(0,177,227)` |
| **Clone** | no change on any property |

---
### Planning note
Serialized behind the star-glyph fix: same "How we are rated" widget / same component files, so the two must not run as concurrent lanes (file-conflict dep, not a logical one).

---
### Routing note (Planning)
`rapid-formations-clone` has **no clone engine** — no `walk-dom-cdp.ts` / `emit-block.ts` /
`verify-clone.ts`, and zero `*Clone` blocks. Every block here is hand-authored, so the
engine-first rule has nothing to diagnose into: this is a **direct fix in the block that
has the defect**. That is why the task is tagged `bug` — it is NOT a fidelity loophole.

**Ship path:** Mode X — `clone-pull-request-create` with per-breakpoint PROD-vs-clone
screenshot proof, land `awaiting-user`, **the USER merges the PR**. Never merge to main.
Live source of truth: `https://www.rapidformations.co.uk` · clone:
`https://rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app`. ⛔ HEADED browser only for any visual check.
acceptanceCriteria: Both the Trustpilot and Google review cards take a `rgb(248,248,248)` background on hover, matching live. Background ONLY — live's rule is `background:#f8f8f8;text-decoration:none` with no border and no colour change, and no transition.
Applies at all four breakpoints (360 / 768 / 1024 / 1800) — live's rule is not media-gated, so the clone's must not be either.
The hover target is the whole card (the full `<a>` area, 293×212 at desktop), not just the text or logo.
Card content — logo, stars, rating text, review count — is unchanged by the hover; only the background/border/text colour changes.
Surrounding section background and card spacing are unaffected in both states.
notes: 2026-08-24 · acceptance criterion 1 CORRECTED on measurement. It previously required a `rgb(0,177,227)` border/text colour on hover in addition to the background. Live does not do that: measured on https://www.rapidformations.co.uk/renewals/ at 1024, the card anchor goes rgba(0,0,0,0) -> rgb(248,248,248) on hover while its border stays `0px none` and the rating `<strong>` stays rgb(89,89,89) in both states. Live's whole rule is `.CustomerReviews--pane:hover{background:#f8f8f8;text-decoration:none}`. The cyan almost certainly came from the anchor's own inherited link colour (rgb(0,177,227)), which is present at REST too and is not a hover effect. Verified independently by the fix lane and by control. ACTION FOR A HUMAN: Linear ticket CORE-7026's text still carries the wrong criterion (Linear MCP not authenticated here, so it could not be updated).
